decisions.reason: Its dedicated 2024 page shows visible commitment, and as an identity-related integration service close to the firm's core enterprise-geospatial offer, management is likely to continue and interpret any weak traction as temporary.

Although it only remained mentioned rather than heavily promoted, the framework is close to the firm's open, extensible GIS direction and as a multi-model product line likely carries enough sunk development effort to encourage continued commitment.

The explicit launch messaging and dedicated 2024 page indicate strong public commitment, while identity and access for GIS applications fits the firm's strategy of integrating geospatial solutions into broader enterprise systems.

This newly launched workshop sits squarely in the firm's consulting and training strengths, and despite lower sunk costs than software products, management would likely keep it for at least another year before judging demand conclusively.
